svg.title: Partakers of the Divine Nature
svg.desc: A one-minute comic in 4 panels. Panel 1 (2 Peter 1:3, 14): Peter, grey-flecked, seated with a scroll on his knee, writing. Caption: "Peter, knowing his death is near, writes." Peter says: "His divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness." Panel 2 (John 15:5, 11): Jesus standing beside a grapevine heavy with clusters, two disciples listening. Caption: "Jesus: “I am the vine; you are the branches.”" Jesus says: "Whoever abides in me and I in him, he it is that bears much fruit." Jesus says: "That my joy may be in you, and that your joy may be full." Panel 3 (2 Peter 1:5; 1 John 5:3): a believer in the street holding out bread to a poor man sitting by the road, another believer walking beside an old man with a staff. Caption: "For this very reason: the effort of a branch." Peter says: "Make every effort to supplement your faith with virtue." John says: "And his commandments are not burdensome." A strip joins the panels above: Eight qualities, faith to love, each grown “in” the one before. Panel 4 (Matthew 25:21; 2 Peter 1:11): a master by the lit doorway of his house holding out his arms to a servant who comes toward him. Caption: "Jesus’ picture: the master welcomes his servant." The master says: "Well done, good and faithful servant. Enter into the joy of your master." Note: "Read beside the entrance “richly provided” (2 Peter 1:11): the study’s reading." The point: God has given you everything for life and godliness and a share in His nature. So give every effort, the glad effort of a branch: the fruit is His, the load is light, and the welcome is joy (2 Peter 1:3-11).
svg.text: Given everything, the branch bears fruit
